headline: Bitcoin price hits two-year low amid AI investment concerns
summary: Bitcoin's price fell to its lowest level in two years on Friday. Analysts attribute the decline to growing investor concerns regarding the profitability of AI-related investments, which has triggered broader market instability.
why: Bitcoin is often used as a barometer for risk appetite. A sharp decline in crypto markets often reflects broader liquidity issues or a shift in investor sentiment away from speculative assets.
why_moved: Investor sentiment shifted away from speculative assets like Bitcoin due to concerns over the sustainability of AI-driven market valuations.
